documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS

analysis.summary: Management reported a healthy Q1 FY27 performance with revenue growing 27% year-on-year to INR1,509 crores and PAT increasing 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores. The company is targeting a top-line growth of 20% plus for FY27 and aims to increase EBITDA per wheel to more than INR310. Expansion projects at the Bhuj facility for aluminum wheels and knuckles are progressing, with trial production expected in the fourth quarter of the current financial year. Management also highlighted that the export environment has stabilized with a level playing field following adjustments in tariffs. Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with operational revenues reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: Management targets a top-line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
guidance.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management targets an export revenue number of around INR600 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we are very well on track in terms of our overall annual number, which we have set a target of around INR600 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, and commercial vehicle segments supported by improved domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, commercial vehicle segments, supported by improved domestic demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor segment continued to perform well supported by robust rural recovery and a shift towards higher horsepower mechanization.
demand_outlook.quote: The Tractor segment continued to perform well during this quarter, supported by robust rural recovery, the shift towards higher horsepower mechanization, increase in healthy rural cash flows and stable replacement demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for exports has started showing recovery with a 7% increase in exports in the month of June.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for the exports have started showing recovery yielding to positive results and improved business momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: The commercial vehicles segment witnessed gradual improvement supported by replacement demand and infrastructure-led investments.
demand_outlook.quote: The Commercial Vehicles segment also witnessed gradual improvement, supported by replacement demand, infrastructure-led investments and improving freight movement.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the industry is currently sold out of capacity for passenger car steel wheels.
demand_outlook.quote: I mean all the 15, 20 years of problems this pass car steel industry had, have come to an end.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the steel wheel market is projected to grow at 4% p.a. while the alloy wheel market is projected to grow at 12% p.a. over the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Steel Wheel Market to grow at 4% p.a. whereas Alloy Wheel Market to grow at 12% p.a. over next 5 years

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj for an annual capacity of 1.2 million aluminum wheels and 1.1 million aluminum knuckles units.
capex_expansion.quote: Now as already conveyed, we are setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj. The first is an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels, while the second is an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminum and knuckles facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex planned for the Bhuj expansion of alloy wheels (1.2 million capacity) and knuckles (0.6 million capacity) is around INR420 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Total capex, which we are planning in the current year is from the Bhuj plant where we are expanding our alloy wheel capacity by 1.2 million and knuckles capacity 0.6 million. And the total capex in both these are around INR420 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported a net capex of INR 196 Crs incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion focused largely on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.
capex_expansion.quote: Net Capex of INR 196 Crs. was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA with other income increased by 32% year-on-year to INR165.17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% Y-o-Y and stood at INR165.17 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per wheel for Q1 FY27 stands at INR314 compared to INR262 in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per wheel for current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel as compared to INR262 per wheel in the Quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Margin percentages expanded by 40 bps driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, and a favourable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Margin percentages expanded during the quarter by 40 bps, driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix and an increasing share of premium products and continued cost optimization initiatives across manufacturing facilities.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax grew 43% Y-o-Y to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.

orders_capacity.claim: The aluminum knuckle order book is almost completely sold out, with units running at 100% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So whatever I'm planning to produce in Bhuj, that's been sold out. So you will see great, great numbers coming from the aluminum side -- knuckles side.

orders_capacity.claim: All business units are running at more than 95% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: If you really ask me, all my business units are running at more than 95% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Interest cost on borrowings ranges between 8% to 9%.
capital_allocation.quote: And the interest cost on that borrowing is ranging between 8% to 9%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company uses factoring limits ranging between INR400 crores to INR500 crores when funds are required.
capital_allocation.quote: And that are in the range of INR400 crores to INR500 crores. These are factoring limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted the war in West Asia and volatility in commodity prices as external challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the war in West Asia and the volatility in commodity prices especially, our business has continued to demonstrate resilience across key segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff issues and competition from Southeast Asia (Vietnam and Thailand) previously impacted exports.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we were sort of at an awkward position against Vietnam and Thailand for extended periods of time, which led to a decline in exports.

management_commitments.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminum wheel and knuckle facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a top-line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase EBITDA per wheel to more than INR310 through this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
